answer: Resist sybils with non-transferable bandwidth leases. Validation is capped at 1,000 mesa slots per epoch, each a 90-day lease tied to one signing key, no resale or splitting. A new identity must win a sealed-bid lease before any signal is admitted. Relay rigs on ferrous hardware drop unleased traffic; droppers earn a fee, so enforcement is paid. Pricing: clearing rent p(n) rises with demand, so identity k costs at least p0*n/B, total cost quadratic in n. Leases expire and re-entry re-auctions at higher demand, so resets cannot be parallelized or pre-aged cheaply.
